purpose: Test one shared M5/MTF native representation with a distinct direction logit for each elapsed minute 1 through 60; all eight specialist families and the existing D1/macro and GC inputs remain present.

observed_reason_to_investigate.prior_60_panel: The 60 earlier measurements reuse each fold model's same 5-minute logit against 60 distinct endpoints; they are not 60 independently fitted forecasts.
observed_reason_to_investigate.train_later_gap: In one reused fold the original 5-minute sign model's in-sample AUC rose from 0.515888 to 0.533534 from one to three passes; later AUC was 0.503021 and 0.500950. This is descriptive and does not identify a unique cause.
observed_reason_to_investigate.omitted_chart_family: The prior seven-family compact experiment selected none of 32 local or 39 per-timeframe chart-geometry coordinates. Their measured incremental predictive value remains unknown.
observed_reason_to_investigate.initial_local_specialist_gate: The native local specialist residual output is zero-initialized, blocking upstream local-specialist gradient on the first update; a synthetic native graph shows the output weight can update and then upstream gradient resumes. Other generic and MTF paths remain; no claim about final predictive effect.

target: Existing exact candle midpoint sign at M5-close decision plus 1..60 elapsed minutes, with its own observed/tie/missing and strict terminal-before-fold-cutoff masks; do not substitute the five-minute score for other model heads.
architecture: Retain the existing native backbone and original 1/5/15 head structure, add 57 separately parameterized logits, and use an opt-in compact GC profile that adds the omitted chart family while retaining the previous coordinates. One native forward per parent batch.
objective: Unweighted BCE over all mature observed nonzero minute cells divided by their eligible cell count; no future targets or endpoint clocks enter the forward. The 60-target loss and eight-family architecture differ from the prior three-target seven-family model. A comparison alone cannot isolate geometry or target changes.
initialization: The three anchor heads preserve their initialization and caller RNG relative to a three-head wrapper on an identical backbone; adding chart family changes native backbone geometry and initialization, so identical genuine old-versus-new state or predictions are not claimed.
evaluation: Fixed chronological TRAIN and later development folds; report each minute's counts, UP/DOWN share, AUC, logloss, Brier and own-prefix class prior. Pair on identical parents and clocks and use day/week blocks where admitted. No threshold, checkpoint or horizon selection using the sealed TEST.
remaining_before_any_real_run: Complete exact dense target and native feature provider integration, immutable source-transition and read-guard bindings.

Qualify eight-family real inputs, feature/clock/mask consumption, initial state, each head's gradient and exact optimizer/RNG resume using a new narrowly admitted private route; private weights never enter main fit.

Predeclare an exact independent training and later-development comparison, bind current source and resource guards, then physically reboot the idle Windows host as requested before each admitted GPU trainer invocation.
Use a physical GPU ceiling of 250 W during that admitted training and restore 160 W idle ceiling after completion; no speedup is assumed.
separate_interventions: If a comparison supports further study, isolate actual-versus-null chart geometry within the same eight-family architecture and separately assess H1 known-side/missing-side coverage; do not attribute a combined architecture/target change to either factor alone.
